scope: HIGH-LEVEL CONSTRAINTS ONLY. No architecture, widths, losses, thresholds or predictor choice are specified here.

high_level_constraints.constraint: The benefit predictor MUST be pre-refinement: every input must be available BEFORE the expensive refinement is executed.
high_level_constraints.rationale: the compute-saving property is the primary mechanical difference from post-hoc verifiers (JFS)

high_level_constraints.constraint: The predictor inputs MUST be GT-free at inference time.
high_level_constraints.rationale: Phase 22 showed GT-derived quantities are not deployable; the label may use GT, the input may not

high_level_constraints.constraint: The training target MUST derive from the PAIRED refinement gain (refined quality minus global quality) under a frozen, pre-declared decision rule.
high_level_constraints.rationale: anchors the contribution to the audited target formulation; the rule must be frozen before training

high_level_constraints.constraint: The expensive refinement MUST NOT be required in order to compute the gate signal.
high_level_constraints.rationale: otherwise no compute is saved and the pre-execution claim collapses

high_level_constraints.constraint: A fallback MUST preserve the global output whenever the refinement is skipped or rejected.
high_level_constraints.rationale: 'performance-preserving' is the load-bearing adjective; it must be enforced structurally

high_level_constraints.constraint: If resource/device cost is retained, it MUST appear as an EXPLICIT term in the decision utility (e.g. gain minus lambda*cost), not as an implicit assumption.
high_level_constraints.rationale: otherwise the resource component is engineering, not a defensible contribution

high_level_constraints.constraint: Development labels MUST be constructed from TRAIN only.
high_level_constraints.rationale: the predictor must not see the evaluation population during training

high_level_constraints.constraint: The frozen Phase-22 VAL population (808 cases) MUST NOT be reused as benefit-predictor training data.
high_level_constraints.rationale: Phase 22's policies were all evaluated on the population they were inspected on; reusing it as training data would destroy any out-of-sample claim

high_level_constraints.constraint: A held-out, never-inspected evaluation population MUST be designated BEFORE any routing policy is fitted.
high_level_constraints.rationale: the Phase-22 routing regrets are post-hoc and optimistically biased; out-of-sample evidence requires a held-out protocol

high_level_constraints.constraint: The method name MUST NOT contain 'certified' or 'counterfactual' unless the corresponding evidence is produced (see terminology audits).
high_level_constraints.rationale: terminological overclaim is the easiest reviewer objection

high_level_constraints.constraint: TEST MUST remain closed: 0 image reads, 0 mask reads, 0 inference, 0 visualizations.
Closest prior art (JFS, metareasoning, cascades, CATE, Med-DANet V2, M4oE) MUST be cited and explicitly differentiated in the Phase-24/25 write-up.
high_level_constraints.rationale: the contribution survives only if its margin to each is stated plainly

explicitly_not_decided_here: loss function (regression vs classification vs distributional)
phase24_task_statement_proposed: Specify a narrowed, pre-registered architecture and protocol for a pre-execution, GT-free, benefit-aware gate over an optional refinement within shared multi-domain medical segmentation, including an explicit resource-cost utility term and a preservation-fallback, with a held-out evaluation population designated in advance. No implementation, training or TEST access.
